title: 桌面端「返回首页」两处剩余文案：StudioAccessRequired 按钮与 AI 不可用提示改读「返回应用起始页」
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Follow-up to #37163 (PR #37204), part of #36107. These are two places in the same family that read "home" on desktop, where the target is the app's start page. The dev found them by reading the code; their reach has not been measured.

## What

1. **`StudioRoute.tsx`'s `StudioAccessRequired`** shows 「Back to home」, but on desktop (≥768px) it goes to the app start page. #37204 made `BackToHomeButton`, `AiUnavailable`'s button and the product mark's aria-label read `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` 「Back to app start page」 on desktop. Do the same here. This file is in PR #37166's diff, so this item waits for #37166 to land.
2. **`console.ai.unavailableError`** (「…or head back home.」) disagrees with the button text on desktop. The fix needs a desktop variant key in all 11 locales, so check `Clause-②` again: an added key is `yes (widening)`.

## Done when

- On desktop, both read the app-start-page wording, and phone keeps the current text, as #37204 does.
- One pin each. A new i18n key is added in every locale, and the coverage gate is green.

## Not in scope

Two stale comments seen in passing: the `runtime-config.ts` `hideSingleAppSwitcher` note and an `approvals.json` checklist step. Fix them if they are touched anyway; they get no card of their own.

Blocked-by: #37166
